'''Laertos Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Laertos]]. [[Docking bay 5662]] was situated in the facility, which contained a [[Maintenance storage locker 13A1|maintenance storage locker]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as [[Drop Point: Laertos]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}} {{C|"Operation Nighthook Drop Points" capsule}}</ref>
